newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur shares jump more than five pct.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur shares jump more than five pct.

text.p: Shares of Winterthur Insurance were up sharply in active trading amid a flurry of option-related activity and unconfirmed rumours that it could reinforce its ties with Credit Suisse Group, dealers said.

"Something has to happen," one trader said, adding that fundamental factors or "old rumours" could not explain the advance. Company officials were not available for comment. Shares were up 70 Swiss francs to 1,406, off a high of 1,434.
Another trader said BZ Bank, which says it and its customers control around 20 percent of Winterthur, could be trying to exert more influence. BZ was unavailable.
